name: Chase Sapphire Reserve

booking_insights.hotel: Hotel bookings almost always favor this card: 8X UR via Chase Travel portal at 1.5¢/pt = 12¢ per $1 — far ahead of Amex Gold (2X at 1.0¢ = 2¢) and WF Autograph (3X at 1.0¢ = 3¢). Stack with the $300 travel credit and $500 The Edit credit for maximum value.
booking_insights.lyft: Lyft earns 5X UR (4X bonus + 1X base) at 1.5¢/pt = 7.5¢ per $1 — beats WF Autograph's 3X on transit (3.0¢). Bonus valid through September 30, 2027. Also includes a $10/month Lyft credit when card is added to the Lyft app.
booking_insights.car_rental: WF Autograph earns more points on car rentals (3X = 3.0¢ vs 1X = 1.5¢ here). However, paying with CSR includes complimentary Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver — decline the rental company's CDW/LDW and save $15–30/day. Factor in that saving when deciding which card to use.
booking_insights.doordash: On top of 3X dining points, you get $5 off one restaurant DoorDash order per month AND two $10-off discounts on non-restaurant DoorDash orders per month — requires active DashPass membership.

redemption.points_boost_note: Select flights/hotels on Chase Travel may offer up to 2x points value via Points Boost promotions

point_valuation.cpp_note: Using 1.5 cpp as default ranking value — guaranteed rate through Chase Travel portal for CSR cardholders. Points Boost on select hotels can push this up to 2.0 cpp.

chase_travel_portal_standard.note: Standard redemption through Chase Travel portal — guaranteed for all CSR cardholders on flights, hotels, car rentals.

points_boost_hotels.note: Maximum value via Points Boost on select rotating hotels (look for blue rocket ship icon on chasetravel.com). Primarily available on 'The Edit' luxury collection. List of eligible hotels rotates and is not fixed — check portal at time of booking.
points_boost_hotels.todo: Add specific Points Boost hotel list when available

the_edit_hotels.note: Booking through 'The Edit' collection on Chase Travel often qualifies for Points Boost (up to 2 cpp) and includes perks like breakfast and property credits. Can be stacked with the $300 annual travel credit and $500 The Edit credit.

transfer_to_partners.note: Transferring to airline/hotel partners (Hyatt, United, Southwest, etc.) can match or exceed 1.5 cpp depending on the redemption. Hyatt transfers are widely considered the highest-value option (often 2.0+ cpp for luxury properties).

statement_credit.note: Lowest value option — avoid unless necessary

point_valuation.best_practice: Always book through Chase Travel portal to get at least 1.5 cpp. For luxury hotels, check for the Points Boost rocket icon to potentially get 2.0 cpp. For non-Chase-Travel hotels, consider transferring to World of Hyatt for highest value.
